# A Key Missing

*For the first time in thirty-four years a key is missing from Osbert's ring: the old cistern key, by the cellar drain. Clear the black rats of the Cisterns and search the silt.*

## Objectives

1. Reach [The Cisterns](../maps/cisterns.md)
2. Defeat 30 [Black Drain Rat](../monsters/black_drain_rat.md) in [The Cisterns](../maps/cisterns.md)
3. Look at a glint in the silt in [The Cisterns](../maps/cisterns.md)
